AI-Augmented Data Analyst
About the role
As an AI-Augmented Data Analyst , you will make an impact by transforming complex data into actionable insights that support better decision-making across underwriting, claims, finance, and operational functions. You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences.
This role combines traditional analytics expertise with emerging AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, governance, and data quality.
In this role, you will:
+ Develop and optimize analytical solutions using Snowflake SQL and modern data analysis tools to support enterprise reporting and decision-making.
+ Perform exploratory data analysis on large structured and semi-structured datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
+ Build and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and reporting assets that support business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives.
+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business questions into measurable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
+ Apply AI-augmented analytics techniques to improve data exploration, pattern recognition, and insight generation while ensuring results are accurate, transparent, and business-relevant.
+ Develop reports, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations that communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Implement data quality controls, validation routines, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted analytical assets.
+ Document business rules, data lineage, analytical methodologies, and reporting logic to support governance and knowledge sharing.
+ Partner with data engineering teams to improve data availability, integration, performance, and analytic readiness.
+ Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance, operational effectiveness, customer behavior, and business strategy.
+ Promote responsible, ethical, and compliant use of data and AI-assisted analytics technologies.
Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants within the Eastern Time Zone (EST) . While Hartford, CT is the preferred location, qualified remote candidates located within EST will also be considered.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you need to have to be considered
+ 6+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, or related disciplines.
+ Strong expertise in Snowflake SQL, query optimization, and analytical data modeling.
+ Experience performing exploratory data analysis, trend analysis, statistical analysis, and business performance assessments.
+ Hands-on experience developing analytical datasets, reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
+ Experience working with structured and semi-structured data in cloud-based analytics environments.
+ Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and governance practices.
+ Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven recommendations.
+ Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to work independently in a distributed team environment while managing multiple priorities.
These will help you stand out
+ Experience in the Property & Casualty Insurance industry.
+ Knowledge of underwriting, claims, policy administration, pricing, actuarial analysis, or insurance operations.
+ Experience with AI-assisted analytics, augmented analytics, or Generative AI-enabled analytical tools.
+ Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
+ Experience supporting regulatory reporting, operational performance measurement, and executive reporting initiatives.
+ Knowledge of cloud data platforms and modern analytics architectures.

Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Applications will be accepted until November 20, 2026.
The annual salary for this position is between $115,000- $135,000 , depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other factors permitted by applicable law.
This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable compensation plans.

The salary range provided reflects Cognizant's good-faith estimate of compensation for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation offered will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs.
Cognizant is committed to providing competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our associates.

Title: GFR 161 Data Analyst

Department: Latino Education Institute

Supervisor: Maria Juncos-Gautier

SSTA Approver: Maria Juncos-Gautier

General Statement of Duties:

Under the leadership of the Executive Director and with the support of Program Managers, the Data Analyst will collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data related to the Latino Education Institute's (LEI) programs via pre- and post-surveys, questionnaires, interviews, observations, and other data collection methods as needed. The data will be used for various reports to funders, the community, and WSU. It will also support the revision and enhancement of programs, curricula, communication, and field activities. The candidate must be knowledgeable about or very familiar with different data collection software and programming, especially QuickBase, the software we use to collect, store, and analyze data. It is important to have the willingness and interest to learn how to use QuickBase.

Responsibilities:

1. Maintain the data collection system following "The Program Navigation Guide, LEI Data Collection Tools."

2. Collaborate with the Executive Director and Program Managers throughout the year to collect and properly store quantitative and qualitative data by implementing various evaluation tools used in our programs (e.g., pre-and post-surveys, questionnaires, interviews, observations, and others).

3. Analyze the quantitative and qualitative data collected using QuickBase to provide results and identify trends and insights.

4. Work with our QuickBase software representative for training and troubleshooting as needed.

5. Generate reports summarizing data related to demographics, outputs/outcomes (results), and trends per program. This may include the analysis of large datasets and effective visual representations of results (e.g., charts, graphics, tables).

6. Support Program Managers in assessing the results and impact of their programs and services based on the programs' goals and objectives and/or Logic Models.

7. Manage historical student data files to monitor performance trends.

8. Provide staff with training and support on data collection, input into QuickBase, analysis, and reporting as needed.

9. Design and implement new data collection tools, such as surveys and questionnaires, for new or specific events or programs based on the goals of these events and programs if needed.

10. Conduct online research to gather new data from reliable/official sources related to demographics and social and health-related trends in the Latinx community at a local, state, or national level.

11. To collect quantitative and qualitative data (like program observations and interviews), attend late afternoon programs (after school) and out-of-school programs (Saturdays or during the summer). Occasional evening events may also need to be attended.

12. Perform other duties as assigned as Data Analyst.

Required Qualifications:

1. A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a social science research field or in statistics and computer science with a strong research component.

2. 1 or 2 years of experience working with diverse cultural and economic background populations in data collection, storage, and analysis.

3. Willingness and ability to work with data collection software, especially QuickBase. Willingness to learn and/or manage large datasets using QuickBase for data collection, storage, and analysis.

4. Proficiency in Microsoft Office software, particularly Microsoft Excel. Experience with SPSS is a plus.

5. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

6. Effective collaboration with diverse stakeholder groups, including administrators, program managers, teachers/instructors, and parents.

7. Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment.

8. Capacity to work in interdisciplinary, cross-functional, and multicultural settings.

9. Consistent and dependable attendance record.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Master's degree in a social science research field.

2. Possession of a valid driver's license/state ID and access to transportation for outreach activities.

3. Bilingual proficiency is preferred in English and Spanish.

Worcester State University is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer which seeks to reflect the diversity of its community.

This is a part-time, non-benefited, hourly position.

Hourly Rate: $35 per hour

Role location: U.S.
About the role:
The Senior Financial Data Analyst supports data analysis efforts related to insurance systems development, including data conversions, data preparation, and the maintenance of reference data that supports downstream systems such as the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Oracle General Ledger, and Ceded Reinsurance platforms.
A key focus of this role is partnering with the Finance team throughout the financial close process. This includes validating that data from source systems is accurately reflected in the EDW, ensuring premium calculations are producing expected results, investigating variances, and resolving discrepancies before results are posted to the General Ledger. The role also supports financial reconciliations and helps finalize reporting outcomes.
In addition, the Senior Financial Data Analyst is responsible for documenting source-to-target reconciliations, tracking data variances through resolution, and supporting compliance with audit and SOX requirements.
This position manages a prioritized backlog of development requests and user stories, ensuring business requirements are clearly documented and accurately represent stakeholder needs. The analyst works closely with developers to clarify requirements, validate completed solutions, and obtain business approval before implementation.
The Senior Financial Data Analyst partners closely with the VP, Insurance Enterprise Data to prioritize initiatives across the organization and collaborates with the Project Manager to coordinate releases, communicate changes, and support successful deployment of enhancements into the production environment.
Base salary for the selected candidate will range from $150,000 to $175,000, commensurate with candidate experience and expectations. Additionally, Vantage offers its colleagues performance-based bonus potential, strong health & welfare benefits, retirement plan, competitive time off plans, a highly flexible work environment, and much more.
Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

Supports the VP of Insurance Enterprise Data to ensure effective and timely development of new and/or enhanced systems/technologies.
Provides deep technical and business analysis of data such that developers can effectively create solutions that assist leaders with data-driven decision making.
Creates source-to-target mappings with support from functional business representatives.
Owns the process of user and technical story writing for all work to be delivered.
Maintains a groomed backlog, ensuring each story includes a clear, concise description, acceptance criteria, a developer point estimate, and an agreed-upon delivery expectation with the business.
Owns the process of obtaining business sign off on all stories being deployed to production as well as ensuring the code is released to production on a timely basis. This requires close consultation with developers to ensure proper evidence and documentation support the release.
Completes the business analysis activities and helps the development team understand the analysis.
Supports quality assurance efforts for assigned systems/technologies through vendors, system integrators, and internal development teams.
Design test cases and testing scenarios working with QA engineers.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of professional experience.
5-7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, or financial systems support, ideally within the P&C insurance or reinsurance industry.
Experience working with data warehouses, general ledger systems, and financial close processes is preferred.
Strong knowledge of Property and Casualty Insurance, including policy life cycle, policy structure, and core data elements typically captured.
Experience working with financial data, particularly data feeding the General Ledger and supporting internal and external financial reporting.
Exposure to the audit process in providing evidence and support for financial controls.
Thorough understanding of Unearned Premium logic and derivation (including DAC). Experience with validating and correcting logic used for the calculation.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge finance, IT, and development teams. Must be comfortable speaking with and presenting to senior business leaders with respect to data solutions and challenges.
Basic SQL skills and the ability to read and understand ETL code and logic.
Sharp analytical skills – ability to triage data issues and recommend corrective action.
Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with various data architectures (ODS, Data Lake, Data Marts, etc.).
Keen understanding of data transformations using Reference/Master data.
Exposure to cloud implementations using structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data methods.
Knowledge of application deployment & test automation products, processes, and best practices to ensure full source-to-target reconciliation.
Good understanding of Agile development methods and their application to company technology needs.

Our Vantage Values
Do What’s Right – be a force for good, for our customers, shareholders, colleagues, industry and communities.Be Relentlessly Curious – ask questions, listen to understand, challenge the status quo, look for ways to say YES, drive innovation, be opportunistic and disciplined.We’re Better Together – collaborate, be inclusive, supportive, respectful and humble, be a trusted partner internally and externally.Be Transparent – in who you are, what you think, and how you work, seek and provide alternative points of view, be true to yourself.Make A Difference – focus on impact, embrace technology, leverage data and analytics as critical assets, act intentionally to deliver on our mission.

**About the Opportunity**

# **Job Summary**

To meet the challenges of the university’s continued growth and expansion, the HR Platforms (HRIT) team is looking for a qualified candidate who will contribute to the support and data analytics of Workday HCM.  This is a hybrid position; required to be ON CAMPUS Mon, Tues, Thurs, Fri (Wed is remote).

The HR Platforms (HRIT) Reporting & Data Analyst serves as a key data and reporting resource within HR Platforms, partnering with HR functional areas, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and deliver accurate, meaningful workforce data and analytics.

This role requires a strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, particularly within the complexities of a decentralized higher education environment with diverse employee populations, organizational structures, and business practices.

The Reporting & Data Analyst translates business needs into effective reporting and analytical solutions, developing and maintaining Workday reports, SQL queries, and other data solutions. The role analyzes complex datasets to identify trends, discrepancies, anomalies, and data integrity issues; investigates root causes; and provides insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

This position also partners closely with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional teams to test, validate, and resolve data and reporting issues.

Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, expert proficiency in Excel, proficiency in SQL, attention to detail, and a naturally curious mindset. The successful candidate will be comfortable asking questions, challenging data that does not appear correct, investigating complex issues, and translating analytical findings into clear, actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences. The role requires sound judgment, initiative, strong customer service skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining confidentiality and the highest standards of data integrity.

Key responsibilities include:

·         Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and translate data needs into accurate, sustainable reporting and analytical solutions.

·         Develop, maintain, and enhance reports and queries using Workday HCM/Payroll, Prism, SQL, Excel, and other reporting and analytical tools.

·         Analyze and reconcile complex HR and Payroll datasets to identify trends, anomalies, discrepancies, and data integrity issues and investigate root causes.

·         Collaborate with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional partners on requirements, testing, validation, system changes, and resolution of data and reporting issues.

To support the University's essential services and business operations, this position may occasionally be required to work outside of regular business hours, including during critical system activities, reporting deadlines, or other periods of operational need.

# **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Human Resources, Data Analytics, or a related field required.
* 3–5 years of progressive experience in HR data analytics, HR systems, reporting, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing complex HR and payroll data.
* Strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, including the ability to understand how transactions, business processes, organizational structures, compensation, time, absence, payroll, and employee lifecycle events impact downstream data and reporting.
* Experience with Workday reporting across HCM and Payroll, including developing, maintaining, interpreting, and troubleshooting reports and identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and effectiveness.
* Higher education HR and Payroll experience is strongly preferred, with an understanding of the unique organizational structures, academic populations, employee types, appointments, positions, grants/funding, faculty/staff populations, and other complexities common to higher education.
* Expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas/functions, pivot tables, lookups, data cleansing, conditional logic, data validation, reconciliation, and analysis of large and complex datasets. Experience using Excel to identify trends, anomalies, discrepancies, and data-quality issues is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in SQL, with the ability to query, join, filter, aggregate, and analyze complex datasets across multiple tables and data sources.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a naturally curious mindset and the ability to recognize when data does not make sense and independently investigate the underlying issue, ask insightful questions, identify patterns and anomalies, determine root causes, and translate findings into meaningful business insights. 
* Demonstrated ability to work with large, complex, and sensitive HR and Payroll datasets, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, completeness, consistency, and confidentiality.
* Experience with data reconciliation and validation, including comparing data across Workday and downstream systems, identifying discrepancies, researching root causes, and partnering with functional and technical teams to resolve issues.
* Ability to translate complex HR and Payroll business requirements into meaningful reporting and data solutions, including gathering requirements, understanding the underlying business need, and recommending appropriate reporting or analytical approaches.
* Experience with data management, reporting governance, documentation, testing, and systems changes, including developing test plans and test cases and validating the impact of system changes on data and reporting.
* Workday Prism Analytics experience preferred, particularly experience working with multiple data sources and complex datasets.
* Experience with Cognos or other enterprise reporting/analytics tools preferred.
* Ability to interpret and communicate data clearly, translating complex analysis and technical findings into concise, actionable information for HR leadership, functional partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, with the ability to recognize when data does not make sense and independently investigate the underlying issue.
* Strong customer-service and consulting mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, clarify ambiguous requests, provide thoughtful recommendations, and deliver high-quality reporting and analytical solutions.
* Self-starter with strong initiative and sound judgment, capable of working independently while knowing when to escalate issues or engage appropriate technical and functional partners.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-volume environment, organize work effectively, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business and project requirements.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the organization.
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to partner effectively across HR, Payroll, HR Technology, IT, and other university functions.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee, HR, and Payroll information with discretion and in accordance with university policies and data-security requirements.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, with the ability to identify opportunities to automate, simplify, improve data quality, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of HR reporting and analytics.

  
  

# **Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

  

**Reporting and Analytics**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance Workday HCM and Payroll reports and SQL queries to meet complex HR, Payroll, operational, compliance, and business requirements.
* Analyze complex HR and Payroll data from Workday and other data sources to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Serve as a reporting and data analytics subject matter expert for HR and Payroll, providing expertise to troubleshoot reporting issues, investigate discrepancies, and determine root causes.
* Partner with HR and Payroll stakeholders to understand business needs and translate requirements into effective reporting and analytical solutions, recommending the most appropriate reporting approach or data source.
* Provide advanced Excel-based analysis and data reconciliation, including analyzing large datasets, identifying discrepancies, validating results, and developing meaningful insights for HR leadership and business partners.
* Develop and support ad-hoc and standardized reporting capabilities that enable HR users and leadership to access timely, accurate, and actionable workforce information.
* Evaluate existing Workday reports and the report library to identify opportunities to leverage, enhance, consolidate, or retire existing reports and reduce redundant reporting.
* Establish and maintain reporting documentation, including report definitions, data sources, business logic, calculations, dependencies, and intended use to support consistency and knowledge sharing.
* Support reporting testing and validation associated with Workday releases, system changes, integrations, and business process changes, ensuring data and reporting outcomes remain accurate.
* Develop, analyze, and deliver recurring workforce metrics and reporting packages, including quarterly metrics and other HR leadership reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and meaningful interpretation of results.
* Monitor and promote data quality and reporting integrity, partnering with HR, Payroll, and technical teams to research and resolve data discrepancies and reporting issues.
* Provide reporting guidance, training, and support to HR users, helping users understand available reporting capabilities, interpret report results, and use data appropriately for decision-making.
* Serve as a resource for HR staff and leadership on Workday reporting capabilities, including advising on report design, data availability, appropriate use of Workday data, and limitations of reporting outputs.
* Identify opportunities to improve, automate, and streamline reporting processes, leveraging Workday, SQL, Excel, Prism, Cognos, and other available technologies.

  

**Data Integrity & Security**

* Monitor, analyze, and validate HR and Payroll data across Workday and related systems, developing and executing audit queries to proactively identify data quality issues, anomalies, and inconsistencies.
* Reconcile HR and Payroll data across Workday, integrations, and downstream systems, investigating discrepancies and partnering with functional and technical teams to identify root causes and implement resolutions.
* Support data integrity audits, testing, and controls associated with HR systems, integrations, releases, and business process changes, ensuring accurate, complete, and reliable data.
* Protect the confidentiality and security of sensitive HR and Payroll data, adhering to University policies and data governance standards while identifying and escalating potential privacy, security, or access concerns.

  

**Training/Communications**

* Develop and deliver training to HR and Payroll users on Workday reporting, data analysis, and related reporting tools and capabilities.
* Develop, update, and maintain user guides, training materials, job aids, and other documentation to support effective and consistent use of Workday reporting and analytics.
* Develop and maintain a centralized library of standard reports and reporting documentation, including report purpose, data definitions, business logic, and intended use.
* Communicate reporting changes, new capabilities, and data insights to HR stakeholders and provide guidance to help users effectively interpret and utilize HR and Payroll data.

Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Classification is what customers judge us on during proofs of value (PoVs) and renewals: do our results match their data? You will make sure the answer is yes. You will own classification requests for US PoVs, validate results before customer calls, tune classifiers using proven procedures, and bring the hard problems to R&D with everything they need to solve them.

Escalate complex issues to the R&D Data Analysts team with a complete, well-written handoff they can act on without a follow-up call.

**Position Summary**

The Master Data Specialist owns the accuracy, completeness, and governance of supply chain master data across the organization's ERP and business systems. This is a hands-on role in an organization that is actively building its data foundation: the analyst will not only maintain records but help define the standards, processes, and controls that do not fully exist today.

The role covers four core data domains — materials/items, vendors/suppliers, customers, and BOMs/routings — and requires someone comfortable working across multiple systems, executing high-volume data updates, and bringing structure where processes are still informal.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Master Data Maintenance & System Updates**

* Create, update, extend, and deactivate master data records (items/materials, vendors, customers, BOMs, routings) across all ERP and connected systems.
* Execute mass data updates and migrations using system tools, upload templates, and data-loading utilities; validate results before and after changes.
* Ensure cross-system consistency: when a record changes in one system, verify and synchronize dependent systems and downstream processes.
* Process master data change requests within defined SLAs, verifying completeness and required approvals before entry.

**Data Quality & Cleansing**

* Run recurring data quality audits (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent units of measure, invalid statuses, orphaned BOM components) and remediate findings.
* Establish and maintain data quality KPIs and dashboards; report accuracy and completeness metrics to your manager on a defined cadence.
* Lead data cleansing initiatives, including preparation for system implementations, upgrades, or acquisitions.

**Governance & Process Development**

* Help define and document master data standards: naming conventions, field definitions, mandatory attributes, and approval workflows for each data domain.
* Draft and maintain SOPs and work instructions for master data creation and change processes.
* Act as gatekeeper: challenge incomplete or non-standard data requests and route them through the correct approval path.
* Support the rollout of data governance practices to other departments (procurement, sales, finance, operations) that consume or submit master data.

**Cross-Functional Support & Analysis**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for master data questions from procurement, planning, warehouse, sales, and finance teams.
* Support ERP projects, integrations, and system testing where master data is involved (UAT, data validation, cutover support).
* Produce ad hoc analyses and extracts (e.g., item usage, vendor rationalization, BOM cost roll-up inputs) as requested.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in master data maintenance within a supply chain, manufacturing, or distribution environment.
* Demonstrated experience performing master data creation and mass updates directly in at least one major ERP (e.g., SAP, Oracle/NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365); ability to learn additional systems quickly, as this role works across multiple platforms.
* Working knowledge of at least two of the four data domains: material/item master, vendor master, customer master, BOMs/routings.
* IA skills and Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning at scale); experience with data upload/import templates and validation.
* High attention to detail with a documented track record of accuracy in high-volume data work.
* Ability to write clear process documentation and communicate data standards to non-technical colleagues.

**Preferred**

* Experience in an organization building master data governance from an early stage (defining standards rather than inheriting them).
* Exposure to data quality or MDM tools, SQL, or Power BI/reporting tools.
* Experience supporting an ERP implementation, migration, or consolidation.
* Understanding of how master data drives downstream processes: MRP, procurement, costing, and order management.
* APICS/ASCM (CPIM) or similar supply chain certification.

**Competencies**

* **Accuracy and rigor —** treats data errors as defects, not inconveniences.
* **Process orientation —** builds repeatable methods rather than one-off fixes.
* **Ownership —** follows issues to root cause across systems and departments.
* **Communication —** can explain data requirements to requesters and push back constructively on bad inputs.
* **Adaptability —** comfortable in a maturing organization where standards are still being defined.

**Success Measures (First 12 Months)**

* Documented data standards and SOPs in place for all four data domains.
* Baseline data quality audit completed for each domain, with a remediation plan and measurable improvement.
* Master data change-request process defined, communicated, and adopted, with SLA tracking.
* Cross-system data consistency checks established and running on a regular cadence.

**Growth Path**

This role is scoped at the analyst/specialist level with a defined path toward Senior Analyst or Master Data Manager as the organization's data governance function matures.

TPS Group Holdings, a family of brands including The Paper Store and Uncharted, is all about transforming daily routines into joyful escapes that inspire and surprise. Position Overview: The EDI & Vendor Data Analyst owns the day-to-day operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of TPS's Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) environment, along with vendor onboarding and vendor master data. This role serves as the operational subject matter expert for TPS's managed EDI platform and the transaction flows that connect TPS with its trading partners.

As TPS grows its vendor base and expands EDI adoption, this is a high-impact role focused on onboarding new trading partners, keeping transactions flowing, reducing manual work across Buying, Distribution, and Finance, and managing the vendor onboarding process from start to finish.

The EDI & Vendor Data Analyst reports directly to the Manager, Enterprise Applications.

What You’ll Do

• Be a TPS brand ambassador.

• Monitor EDI transaction flows daily and investigate exceptions and failures.

• Support EDI documents including 850 Purchase Orders, 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgments, 856 Advance Ship Notices, compliant shipping labels, and 810 Invoices.

• Troubleshoot and resolve EDI errors in a timely manner, coordinating with vendors, internal teams, and technology partners.

• Manage vendor EDI onboarding from requirements gathering through testing and production implementation for dozens of new trading partners each year.

• Coordinate EDI testing with vendors and internal stakeholders and confirm production readiness.

• Own the vendor onboarding process and vendor master data, including vendor setup in the merchandising system and related systems.

• Troubleshoot vendor record onboarding and cross-system vendor data issues.

• Serve as the primary operational subject matter expert for the EDI platform, including user administration, account management, and configuration.

• Manage the EDI service provider relationship, track service performance, and escalate issues when appropriate.

• Track EDI performance and recurring issues and recommend corrective actions with vendors and internal teams.

• Develop and maintain an EDI onboarding roadmap that prioritizes vendors based on transaction volume, labor savings, error reduction, vendor importance, implementation complexity, and business priorities.

• Identify opportunities for new EDI documents, purchase order automation, and process improvements.

• Maintain EDI procedures, vendor documentation, trading partner requirements, and troubleshooting guides.

• Cross-train with and provide backup support for product data and other business systems functions as needed.

Who You Are

• You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• You understand retail purchase order, receiving, and accounts payable processes and how EDI supports them.

• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and can trace failed transactions to their root cause.

• You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple vendors, issues, and projects simultaneously.

• You communicate professionally with vendors and can hold external partners accountable to agreed-upon requirements and timelines.

• You have strong Excel skills. Experience with SQL, data mapping, or integration platforms is a plus.

• Experience working with a managed EDI service or EDI translator is a plus.

• Experience with vendor master data and vendor setup in an ERP or retail merchandising system is a plus.

• You have strong documentation skills and can create clear procedures and vendor requirements.

• You are interested in using automation and AI tools to reduce manual, repetitive work.

• You can work a minimum of 3+ days per week at the Corporate Office in Acton, MA.

• You maintain a professional presentation in attire, demeanor, and appearance.
